title: MLE5216 · TEM 原理与应用练习

questions.prompt: Which statements correctly describe the information and practical limits of TEM?

options.text: A cross-sectional TEM specimen can reveal buried interfaces and thin-film thickness.
A TEM projection is a direct map of the exposed surface height of a thick specimen.
TEM can examine different areas and magnifications, but thin-specimen preparation and operation can be more demanding than SEM.
Suitable specimen holders allow observations during heating or electrical stressing.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。截面让埋藏的层与界面进入透射观察方向。B：错误。TEM看穿样品，不直接把投影强度变成表面高度。C：正确。TEM也能导航和放大缩小，代价是更复杂的制样与操作。D：正确。原位研究需要适合该实验的专用样品杆，不能认为每支普通样品杆都自动具备这些功能。

重点词：cross section（截面）；transmission（透射）；in situ（原位）
逻辑链：研究埋藏结构 → 制作可透电子的截面 → 观察层厚与界面；研究动态过程 → 配置合适样品杆 → 在受控刺激下记录变化。

questions.prompt: Why can TEM reveal finer details than conventional bulk-sample SEM?

options.text: The transmitted electrons are measured below a thin specimen rather than only collecting reflection-side signals above a thick specimen.
The higher electron energy normally used in TEM gives a shorter electron wavelength.
A thin specimen reduces the lateral spreading that broadens the signal-generating region in a bulk sample.
A larger interaction volume is the main reason for the finer details.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。透射几何配合薄样品，使TEM和常规SEM具有不同的信号路径和作用区域。B：正确。较高动能缩短电子波长，有利于分辨细节，但不是唯一条件。C：正确。薄样品减少横向散射，局域信息不易被较大作用体积混合。D：错误。横向作用区域扩大通常使细节变模糊；不能用“作用体积更大”解释TEM优势。

重点词：lateral spread（横向展宽）；interaction volume（相互作用体积）；wavelength（波长）
逻辑链：薄样品 → 横向散射减少 → 信号更局域；较高束能 → 波长缩短 → 有利于更高空间分辨。不能只比较显示放大倍数。

source.page: TEM PDF pp.17–19,55; Spectroscopy PDF p.9

questions.prompt: Which preparation choices are appropriate for dispersed nanoparticles in TEM?

options.text: The particles and support must allow enough electrons to pass through the region of interest.
A conductive support makes an arbitrarily thick particle suitable for transmission imaging.
A particle suspension can be drop-cast onto a thin carbon or silicon-nitride support film.
A support grid carrying the specimen is mounted in a holder that enters the microscope vacuum.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。关键要求是电子透明，而不是背诵一个对所有材料通用的厚度上限。B：错误。导电性与电子透明性是不同要求，导电并不能取消透射限制。C：正确。这是课件给出的颗粒样品简便路线。D：正确。支撑网与样品杆承载薄样品并将其送入真空中的观察位置。

重点词：electron transparency（电子透明性）；drop-casting（滴涂）；support film（支撑膜）
逻辑链：颗粒分散并滴涂 → 颗粒落在薄支撑膜上 → 观察区可透射电子；厚度要求不能由导电支撑替代。

questions.prompt: When is FIB preparation particularly justified instead of less expensive mechanical thinning?

options.text: A particular small device feature must be included in the TEM cross-section.
Mechanical preparation is unsuitable whenever the final observation region must be thin.
The question requires a site-specific buried interface or local failure region.
FIB is the best choice for every specimen because its main advantage is lower cost.

questions.explanation:
A、C：正确。FIB的关键优势是位点特异，能把目标小结构准确放入截面。B：错误。机械切磨、中心减薄及离子减薄也能得到可透电子的样品。D：错误。课件强调FIB昂贵；“更能选点”不等于“普遍更便宜”。不需要精确选点时，可考虑机械路线。

重点词：site-specific（位点特异）；focused ion beam（聚焦离子束）；failure analysis（失效分析）
逻辑链：目标是特定局部小结构 → 需要精确选点 → FIB有价值；只需代表性截面 → 可采用机械制样与后续离子减薄。

source.page: TEM PDF pp.20–21,55; Spectroscopy PDF p.10

questions.prompt: Which descriptions of the dual-beam FIB lift-out process are correct?

options.text: The Ga+ ion beam mills the specimen while the electron beam helps locate and observe the target.
Local Pt deposition can connect a lamella to a manipulator and later to its support.
The lamella is secured before being released and transferred, and it must still be thinned for electron transmission.
For a suitable non-site-specific sample, cutting, grinding, dimpling and ion milling provide another thinning route.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。双束系统把切削与观察分工。B：正确。局部沉积Pt用于连接，操纵针完成薄片转移。C：正确。先固定再释放可保留目标薄片；转移并不意味着已完成最终减薄。D：正确。机械路线与FIB都必须最终满足电子透明性，只是选点能力和成本不同。

重点词：lamella（薄片）；lift-out（提取）；ion milling（离子减薄）
逻辑链：观察定位目标 → 离子切削并固定薄片 → 转移到支撑网 → 继续减薄至可透电子。

questions.prompt: Which comparisons of the electron sources listed in the lecture are correct?

options.text: LaB6 is a field emitter, while the tungsten field emitter is a thermionic source.
Increasing displayed image magnification makes the source coherence irrelevant.
The field emitter offers the best coherence and resolution among the listed sources, at higher cost.
The inexpensive tungsten hairpin filament has better coherence than the listed field emitter.

questions.explanation:
A：错误。LaB6属于热电子发射源，钨场发射源依靠场发射。B：错误。显示放大不能改变源尺寸、相干性或探针质量。C：正确。课件把场发射源与较好的相干性和分辨能力联系起来，同时指出其成本更高。D：错误。钨发夹丝低价，但不能因此推成相干性最好。

重点词：thermionic emission（热电子发射）；field emission（场发射）；coherence（相干性）
逻辑链：选择电子源 → 决定束流质量与相干条件 → 影响可形成的探针及相位成像能力；显示倍率不能补偿源质量。

questions.prompt: Which statements correctly connect coherence with the electron beam?

options.text: A small source favours spatial, or directional, coherence.
Stable acceleration conditions help maintain consistent electron energies and temporal coherence.
High spatial coherence automatically guarantees high temporal coherence.
Both spatial and temporal coherence are useful when electron-wave interference is used for phase imaging.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。较小源尺寸有助于方向关系一致。B：正确。稳定加速条件减少电子能量与频率的变化，有利于时间相干。C：错误。课件展示两种相干性可以独立变化。D：正确。只检查方向而忽略时间相位关系，或反过来，都不是完整的相干条件。

重点词：spatial coherence（空间相干性）；temporal coherence（时间相干性）；phase（相位）
逻辑链：小源尺寸 → 方向更一致；稳定能量 → 时间相位关系更稳定；两者配合 → 干涉对比更可靠。

questions.prompt: What do DIC and HRTEM have in common when forming image contrast?

options.text: The specimen introduces phase differences into the illuminating waves.
Interference converts those phase differences into measurable intensity differences.
Both techniques form their images by collecting surface secondary electrons.
Their common phase-contrast logic means that they use identical radiation and specimen requirements.

questions.explanation:
A、B：正确。这正是老师Tutorial要求抓住的共同逻辑：样品改变相位，波干涉再把相位差转为明暗。C：错误。DIC使用光，HRTEM使用透射电子波，都不是SEM二次电子图。D：错误。机制有相似处不等于所用波、光路、制样要求完全相同。

重点词：phase difference（相位差）；interference（干涉）；intensity contrast（强度对比）
逻辑链：样品引入相位差 → 波发生相长/相消干涉 → 探测到强度差 → 形成图像明暗。共同机制不等于相同适用范围。

source.page: TEM PDF pp.27,55; Spectroscopy PDF p.11

questions.prompt: Which statements explain diffraction from a periodic array of atoms illuminated by coherent electrons?

options.text: Each atom acts as a point-like scatterer in the Huygens construction.
Specific directions have constructive interference because scattered waves have matching phases.
The direct beam is the forward direction in which the waves can also add constructively.
Every intermediate direction has the same constructive intensity as a diffraction maximum.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。单个原子向不同方向散射电子波。B：正确。多原子散射波在特定方向同相叠加，形成衍射极大。C：正确。直射方向也满足课件所示的相长条件。D：错误。不满足相长条件的中间方向可出现相消，不能认为所有方向一样强。

重点词：Huygens principle（惠更斯原理）；constructive interference（相长干涉）；destructive interference（相消干涉）
逻辑链：原子散射电子波 → 周期排列决定各方向相位差 → 特定方向同相增强、其他方向削弱 → 形成衍射图样。

questions.prompt: Which qualitative consequences of Bragg diffraction are correct?

options.text: At fixed wavelength and reflection order, more closely spaced planes diffract to a larger angle.
At fixed plane spacing, using a shorter wavelength necessarily increases the diffraction angle.
The beam-deflection angle and the angle between the incident beam and the crystal planes are interchangeable.
A larger diffraction angle directly means that the crystal grains are physically larger.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。固定波长和级次时，晶面间距与散射角呈反向关系。B：错误。固定间距时，波长缩短对应更小的Bragg角，不能把间距关系套到波长上。C：错误。课件几何中Bragg角与总束偏转角不同，不能互换；理解光路比死记代入更重要。D：错误。衍射角主要反映晶面间距及条件，不是晶粒尺寸的放大坐标。

重点词：Bragg diffraction（布拉格衍射）；lattice spacing（晶面间距）；scattering angle（散射角）
逻辑链：固定波长与反射条件 → 晶面间距变小 → 相长干涉出现于更大散射角 → 图样反映结构周期而非晶粒外形。

questions.prompt: Which interpretations of TEM diffraction patterns are justified?

options.text: A single crystal can produce discrete spots, while many orientations can produce sharp rings.
A diffraction ring is the intersection of a diffracted cone with the detector plane.
A ring radius directly traces the real-space boundary of a particle.
A central dark shape may be a beam stop protecting the camera rather than a specimen feature.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。参与衍射的晶粒数与取向分布影响斑点、稀疏斑点或环的出现。B：正确。多取向的同一散射角形成锥面，与相机平面相交为环。C：错误。衍射环记录角度和周期性信息，粒子边界应看实空间像。D：正确。必须把挡束器等仪器结构与样品结构区分。

重点词：single crystal（单晶）；polycrystalline（多晶）；beam stop（挡束器）
逻辑链：晶体取向分布不同 → 相长散射方向分布不同 → 形成斑点或锐环；先辨仪器部件，再解释样品。

questions.prompt: When using a TEM diffraction pattern to compare lattice spacings, which statements are justified?

options.text: At the same wavelength and camera settings, a reflection farther from the direct beam corresponds to a larger plane spacing.
Electron diffraction necessarily measures lattice parameters more precisely than X-ray diffraction.
Changing camera length changes the real lattice spacing of an unchanged specimen.
The wavelength and camera geometry must be known or calibrated before interpreting spot positions quantitatively.

questions.explanation:
A：错误。相同设置下，离中心更远表示更大散射角，对应更小而非更大的晶面间距。B：错误。课件复习明确指出电子衍射测晶体结构参数的精度低于XRD；局部分析优势不等于参数精度最高。C：错误。相机长度改变图样几何缩放，并不改变样品晶格。D：正确。同一半径在不同设置下不能未经校准就比较成相同间距。

重点词：camera length（相机长度）；calibration（校准）；lattice parameter（晶格参数）
逻辑链：已知波长与相机几何 → 将斑点位置关联到散射角与晶面间距；改变显示几何 ≠ 改变真实晶格。

source.page: TEM PDF pp.37–38; Spectroscopy PDF p.3

questions.prompt: Why is indexing needed after lattice spacings have been obtained?

options.text: It associates reflections with particular crystal planes rather than leaving them as unassigned distances.
Symmetry-equivalent plane families in a cubic crystal must have different spacings.
Measuring one spacing automatically identifies every crystal phase without considering possible alternatives.
The same set of allowed reflections can be assumed for every crystal structure.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。知道间距之后仍需回答“它属于哪组晶面”，这就是索引的意义。B：错误。立方晶体的对称等价面可共享间距，不能把每个方向变化都当作新相。C：错误。不同候选结构可能有相近间距，需要更多反射及整体一致性。D：错误。fcc、bcc及其他晶系具有不同反射关系。

重点词：indexing（索引）；Miller indices（密勒指数）；equivalent planes（等价晶面）
逻辑链：测得衍射位置 → 得到间距 → 匹配晶面与允许反射 → 综合判断晶体结构；不能只靠一个未标定距离。

questions.prompt: Which reasoning helps distinguish candidate crystal structures from diffraction?

options.text: Compare the pattern of observed spacings and allowed reflections with the candidate structures.
Assume that any pattern containing rings must have the same crystal structure.
Require several reflections to be consistent with one structural interpretation.
Treat a larger pattern on the camera as proof that a different phase has formed, without checking camera settings.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。课件用不同立方结构的反射关系说明相识别逻辑，不必靠背一串数值完成判断。B：错误。环说明取向叠加，不直接指定晶相。C：正确。多条反射的一致性比单条相似间距更可靠。D：错误。相机几何也会改变图样尺度，应先排除设置变化。

重点词：crystal phase（晶相）；allowed reflection（允许反射）；consistency（一致性）
逻辑链：提出候选结构 → 比较多条间距及反射关系 → 检查是否共同一致 → 支持或排除晶相；先控制几何再比较。

questions.prompt: A region changes from sharp diffraction features to broad diffuse rings during irradiation. Which interpretations are justified?

options.text: The later pattern can indicate a loss of long-range crystalline order.
The original specimen must already have been amorphous because any diffraction ring proves disorder.
Irradiation may have changed the specimen, so the final pattern should not automatically be assigned to its initial state.
Broad diffuse rings establish the elemental composition without spectroscopy.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。课件把锐斑或锐环与晶态联系，把宽弥散环与非晶状态联系。B：错误。多晶也可出现锐环，应区分锐环和弥散环。C：正确。测量过程可能改变样品，必须区分初始状态与照射后状态。D：错误。衍射首先提供结构有序性信息，不直接代替元素谱。

重点词：amorphous（非晶）；diffuse ring（弥散环）；beam-induced change（束致变化）
逻辑链：照射使结构有序性下降 → 相干衍射特征变宽/弥散 → 图样变化；必须检查测量是否改变被测对象。

questions.prompt: How does switching TEM from imaging mode to diffraction mode change what is recorded?

options.text: The specimen image is merely enlarged digitally until it becomes a diffraction pattern.
The objective back-focal plane, rather than the ordinary specimen image plane, is projected onto the camera.
Changing beam current alone selects a different physical plane for projection onto the camera.
The selected-area aperture replaces the camera and records the electrons itself.

questions.explanation:
A：错误。数字放大不改变被投影的物理平面。B：正确。衍射模式显示方向/角度信息，成像模式显示样品实空间像。C：错误。束流改变不等于投影平面切换；课件通过调节中间镜强度选择投影平面。D：错误。选区光阑筛选区域，不是记录探测器。

重点词：back-focal plane（后焦面）；image plane（像平面）；intermediate lens（中间镜）
逻辑链：调节中间镜 → 改变投影到相机的平面 → 在实空间图像与衍射角分布之间切换。

questions.prompt: Which aperture–function matches are correct?

options.text: A selected-area aperture restricts which specimen region contributes to a diffraction pattern.
An objective aperture selects electron beams in the diffraction plane and therefore affects the imaging mode.
Movable holes in a metal strip are physical means of selecting an aperture size and position.
The selected-area and objective apertures select the same variable and are interchangeable.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。选区光阑在像平面选哪块样品。B：正确。物镜光阑在后焦/衍射平面选哪些电子束。C：正确。光阑是可移动的实体孔，操作改变其接受范围。D：错误。一个选空间区域，一个选散射方向，位置与功能不能互换。

重点词：selected-area aperture（选区光阑）；objective aperture（物镜光阑）；beam selection（选束）
逻辑链：要选样品位置 → 用像平面选区光阑；要选直射或衍射束 → 用衍射平面物镜光阑 → 决定成像信息。

questions.prompt: Which statements correctly describe bright-field TEM?

options.text: The objective aperture accepts the central direct beam and excludes scattering outside its angular range.
Strong scattering out of the accepted beam can make a region dark.
A dark region must be a hole or the lightest material in the specimen.
Selecting only an off-axis diffracted beam while blocking the direct beam is the ordinary BF condition.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。BF用中心直射束形成亮背景。B：正确。局部电子被散射出接受范围，会减少该处成像计数而变暗。C：错误。暗对比可由厚度、质量散射、衍射或晶格畸变造成，不能只凭明暗定物性。D：错误。该描述属于DF选束。

重点词：bright field（明场）；direct beam（直射束）；scattering contrast（散射对比）
逻辑链：局部散射增强 → 更多电子离开BF接受范围 → 直射计数减少 → 图像变暗；暗并不自动等于某一种结构。

questions.prompt: Which expectations for routine BF-TEM are appropriate?

options.text: It is useful for overview images and measurements of particle size and shape.
A dislocation can appear dark because lattice distortion scatters electrons outside the objective aperture.
If atomic-scale detail is not resolved, increasing displayed magnification alone supplies the missing information.
Its comparatively straightforward alignment makes it useful before choosing a more specialized mode.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。BF适合先找区域并观察尺寸、形状。B：正确。位错周围的晶格畸变改变散射，造成明场计数减少。C：错误。放大像素不增加真实分辨能力，需按任务选择HRTEM等模式。D：正确。常规概览与精细结构分析可以构成连续工作流。

重点词：overview（概览）；dislocation（位错）；resolution（分辨能力）
逻辑链：先用BF定位和测形状 → 根据研究问题选择更合适模式；畸变改变散射 → 电子离开BF光阑 → 位错产生暗对比。

questions.prompt: A region is bright in dark-field TEM when

options.text: It contributes strongly to the diffracted beam selected by the objective aperture.
It necessarily has the highest exposed-surface height.
It necessarily contains the heaviest element, independently of crystal orientation.
It sends most of its electrons only into the direct beam that is blocked in DF.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。DF亮区表示对被选衍射方向有强贡献。B：错误。DF不是表面高度图。C：错误。反射选择与取向很重要，不能把亮区直接当成重元素标签。D：错误。被挡住的直射电子不参与DF成像。可通过光阑偏心或合适束倾斜选入所需衍射束。

重点词：dark field（暗场）；diffracted beam（衍射束）；orientation（取向）
逻辑链：选一束衍射电子并挡直射束 → 只有满足所选散射条件的区域贡献强信号 → 相应区域变亮。

questions.prompt: Two precipitates have similar BF appearance, but only one is bright under a chosen DF condition. Which deductions are justified?

options.text: The dark precipitate may fail to satisfy the selected reflection even if it belongs to the same phase.
Selecting another reflection can change which crystallites are visible.
Every crystal belonging to a phase must be bright under any one selected reflection.
Collecting only a fraction of transmitted electrons can give high contrast but weak signal and longer acquisition.

questions.explanation:
A、B：正确。DF按特定反射筛选，不同取向晶粒对同一反射的贡献不同。C：错误。DF暗不能直接推出该相不存在。D：正确。选束提高特异性，却丢弃许多电子，存在对比与信号量的取舍。

重点词：selected reflection（所选反射）；phase selectivity（相选择性）；signal intensity（信号强度）
逻辑链：选择特定反射 → 只显示满足条件的晶粒 → 获得高选择性/对比；被接受电子减少 → 信号变弱、采集更慢。

questions.prompt: Which configuration and mechanism describe HRTEM?

options.text: Only the central direct beam is allowed through the objective aperture, excluding all diffracted beams.
The direct beam and suitable diffracted beams pass together through the objective aperture.
Interference between the accepted electron waves produces phase contrast.
The periodic atomic-scale contrast discussed in the lecture is obtained without any dependence on crystalline order.

questions.explanation:
A：错误。只留中心束是BF的基本选束逻辑。B、C：正确。HRTEM让直射与衍射波共同参与相干干涉。D：错误。课件的规则晶格对比依赖晶态，非晶区表现为无规则灰度，不能把两者等同。

重点词：high-resolution TEM（高分辨TEM）；phase contrast（相位对比）；crystalline order（晶体有序性）
逻辑链：直射波与衍射波共同通过 → 相位差参与干涉 → 晶格产生周期强度对比；非晶结构不能产生同样规则的晶格图。

questions.prompt: Which interpretation of conventional HRTEM avoids overclaiming atomic positions?

options.text: A bright spot is always an atom column, irrespective of the focus setting.
Changing focus can reverse bright and dark contrast even when the specimen structure has not changed.
The image can reveal very fine layers and lattice structure, but raw contrast alone does not uniquely locate every atom or interface.
A contrast reversal necessarily means that atoms have exchanged places.

questions.explanation:
A：错误。传统HRTEM明暗依赖相位传递与调焦，不能简单作固定原子标签。B：正确。课件展示离焦变化导致对比翻转。C：正确。高分辨能力很有用，但不等于无条件的原子定位；课件随后引出像差校正STEM。D：错误。成像条件改变足以改变明暗，未必发生原子迁移。

重点词：defocus（离焦）；contrast reversal（对比翻转）；atomic position（原子位置）
逻辑链：焦点改变 → 电子波干涉强度改变 → 明暗可翻转；成像对比变化 ≠ 原子位置必然变化。

questions.prompt: A very thin oxide is buried beneath another film. Which plan is appropriate for measuring its thickness with very fine spatial detail?

options.text: Prepare an electron-transparent cross-section containing the buried layer and both interfaces.
Use HRTEM or suitable aberration-corrected STEM after preparing the required cross-section.
Assume that a surface SE-SEM image directly exposes the thickness of the covered oxide.
Replace the spatial-resolution requirement by increasing only the displayed magnification.

questions.explanation:
A、B：正确。老师Tutorial的关键先是几何：埋藏层必须通过截面进入观察方向；然后选择能分辨所需细节的模式。C：错误。表面图不会自动看见被覆盖的内部层厚。D：错误。显示放大不能弥补实际分辨不足。这里考察“目标信息—制样几何—成像模式”匹配，不要求记住题中的具体厚度数值。

重点词：buried layer（埋藏层）；cross-sectional specimen（截面样品）；spatial resolution（空间分辨率）
逻辑链：先明确要测内部层厚 → 做穿过目标界面的薄截面 → 选足够分辨细节的透射模式 → 测量界面间距。

source.page: TEM PDF pp.15,53,55; Spectroscopy PDF p.7

questions.prompt: A composite has bright edges in SE-SEM and a bright inclusion in BSE-SEM. Which comparisons with TEM are justified?

options.text: SE edge brightness can arise from escape geometry even without a change in composition.
A BSE-bright region can indicate stronger nuclear scattering associated with heavier elements.
The bright region must have the same physical meaning in SE, BSE, BF-TEM and DF-TEM.
To interpret a TEM intensity, one should first identify whether direct or diffracted electrons are accepted.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。粗糙边缘更有利于SE逃逸，形貌足以造成亮度变化。B：正确。较大核电荷可增强BSE。C：错误。不同模式接受不同物理信号，不存在通用亮度含义。D：正确。BF和DF首先由接受束不同定义，再讨论具体散射机制。

重点词：topographic contrast（形貌对比）；chemical contrast（成分对比）；detector geometry（探测几何）
逻辑链：先确定模式和所收电子 → 再确定对比来源 → 最后推断样品性质；不能跨设备直接沿用同一“亮=某物性”规则。

questions.prompt: Which distinctions are correct when adjusting electron-microscope imaging conditions?

options.text: Beam current describes electron delivery rate, whereas beam energy describes kinetic energy per electron.
Increasing beam current necessarily shortens the electron wavelength.
In bulk SEM, increasing beam energy can enlarge lateral interaction spread even though the wavelength becomes shorter.
The thin-specimen geometry in TEM helps limit the bulk-scattering broadening relevant to this comparison.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。电流与单电子动能是不同控制量。B：错误。增加每秒电子数不等于增加每个电子动能。C：正确。短波长收益可能被较大横向作用体积抵消。D：正确。这解释为何不能把块体SEM的电压趋势不加条件套到薄样品TEM。

重点词：beam current（束流）；beam energy（束能）；lateral spreading（横向展宽）
逻辑链：束能升高 → 波长缩短，同时在块体中作用体积可能扩大；最终分辨能力需同时看波长和样品内横向展宽。

questions.prompt: A wet, uncoatable insulator needs finer structural detail than a light microscope provides. Which choice follows the tutorial logic?

options.text: Conventional high-vacuum TEM can examine the unchanged thick wet sample simply by increasing magnification.
ESEM can provide a more suitable local specimen environment and help neutralize charging without a conductive coating.
All electron microscopes have identical preparation requirements once electrons replace light.
The required specimen state and the information sought should be considered before ranking instruments only by resolution.

questions.explanation:
A：错误。常规TEM仍有电子透明性与真空等制样要求，放大不能消除。B：正确。ESEM允许样品附近有气体，并可通过正离子中和表面负电荷。C：错误。SEM、ESEM和TEM的几何及环境要求不同。D：正确。保持目标状态是方法选择的条件，不应只比最高分辨率。

重点词：environmental SEM（环境扫描电镜）；charging（充电）；specimen state（样品状态）
逻辑链：样品不能镀膜且需要湿态观察 → 先满足环境与电荷条件 → 选择ESEM等适合方法；最佳分辨率不是唯一标准。

source.page: TEM PDF pp.7,16–20; SEM PDF pp.45–47

questions.prompt: Which structural questions can electron diffraction answer?

options.text: What lattice spacings are present in the selected region?
Which crystal phase is consistent with the observed reflection pattern?
Is the selected material single-crystalline, polycrystalline or amorphous?
What is the exposed-surface height at every point, directly from diffraction intensity?

questions.explanation:
A、B、C：正确。老师Tutorial列出的核心结构信息包括间距、晶相，以及单晶/多晶/非晶状态。需要把图样的几何、允许反射和锐斑/锐环/弥散特征结合起来。D：错误。衍射不是表面高度图；形状尺寸可看实空间像，结构周期看衍射，两者互补。

重点词：lattice spacing（晶面间距）；crystal phase（晶相）；crystallinity（结晶状态）
逻辑链：选定区域 → 测衍射位置及形态 → 判断周期/晶相/有序性；实空间形状与倒易空间结构回答不同问题。

source.page: TEM PDF pp.32,39–41,55; Spectroscopy PDF p.8

questions.prompt: A particle looks dark in BF-TEM. Which additional observations help test the cause rather than assuming a unique composition?

options.text: Selecting a suitable diffracted beam can test whether diffraction contributes to the contrast.
Comparing the particle across suitable imaging conditions can reveal that contrast is condition-dependent.
The BF intensity alone establishes the exact element, so no other signal is useful.
Distortion around a dislocation can alter scattering even without a separate chemical phase.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。改变选束可检查衍射贡献，而不是把单张BF暗区唯一化解释。B：正确。同一区域随模式或成像条件变化的对比有助于约束解释。C：错误。结构强度对比不等于唯一元素指纹，化学问题通常还需相应谱学。D：正确。位错示例说明局部畸变也能造成BF暗对比。

重点词：diffraction contrast（衍射对比）；lattice distortion（晶格畸变）；complementary evidence（互补证据）
逻辑链：观察到暗区 → 提出散射/衍射等候选原因 → 改变选束并结合结构证据 → 排除把亮度直接等同元素的过度推断。

source.page: TEM PDF pp.47–53; Spectroscopy PDF pp.14–17

questions.prompt: Which statements guide an in-situ TEM study of a structural change during heating?

options.text: A suitable holder is needed to control the stimulus while retaining a usable electron-transparent observation region.
BF imaging and local diffraction can provide complementary changes in shape and crystal structure.
A changing HRTEM intensity always proves atomic motion even if focus and imaging conditions also changed.
The observed sequence should be interpreted with awareness that illumination and imaging conditions can affect what is seen.

questions.explanation:
A：正确。原位实验不是只把普通样品放进仪器，还需适合加热等条件的样品杆并保持透射几何。B：正确。实空间像跟踪形状，衍射跟踪局部结构，可联合判断。C：错误。离焦造成的对比翻转也会改变强度，必须控制成像条件。D：正确。课件示例既强调原位动态，也展示照射诱导结构变化，需区分真实样品演化和测量影响。

重点词：in-situ heating（原位加热）；controlled conditions（受控条件）；structural evolution（结构演化）
逻辑链：控制加热与成像条件 → 连续观察同一区域 → 联合形状和衍射变化 → 判断结构演化，同时排除离焦或照射效应。

questions.prompt: A diffraction pattern is collected from a precipitate together with surrounding matrix. Which steps help establish which structure the pattern represents?

options.text: Restrict the contributing specimen region with the selected-area aperture when the geometry allows.
Selecting a diffraction spot with the objective aperture automatically restricts the contributing specimen to the precipitate.
Check the sampled region before assigning every observed reflection to the precipitate.
A pattern with many spots proves that the precipitate itself contains many crystal orientations, even when matrix is included.

questions.explanation:
A 对：选区光阑限制参与衍射的样品区域，可以帮助减少周围基体的贡献；是否能完全隔离目标仍受实际几何限制。
B 错：物镜光阑选择衍射束，决定哪些束参与成像，不等于选择样品中的位置。
C 对：图样必须与被取样的区域对应，混合区域可能同时包含不同结构的贡献。
D 错：当基体也参与时，不能把所有斑点和取向都归给析出物本身。

重点词：selected-area aperture（选区光阑）；objective aperture（物镜光阑）；sampling region（取样区域）。
逻辑链：先确认哪些样品区域贡献信号 → 再把反射与局部结构关联 → 避免把混合图样误判成单个目标的结构。

questions.prompt: A failed device requires both exposed-surface texture and the structure of a particular buried interface to be examined. Which plan is justified?

options.text: Use suitable SE-SEM imaging to examine surface morphology.
Use a suitable electron-transparent cross-section to examine the buried interface in TEM.
The higher resolution of TEM makes its transmission image a direct replacement for any surface-topography measurement.
Site-specific FIB preparation is useful when the cross-section must contain the selected failure location.

questions.explanation:
A 对：SE形貌对比适合回答暴露表面的纹理问题。
B 对：TEM看穿薄样品，截面可使埋藏界面进入观察方向，回答内部结构问题。
C 错：分辨率高不表示信息类型相同；透射投影不直接等价于表面高度或形貌图。
D 对：老师Tutorial强调，FIB的价值在于让薄片包含指定的局部目标，而非因为任何TEM样品都必须使用FIB。

重点词：surface topography（表面形貌）；cross-section（截面）；site-specific preparation（位点特异制样）。
逻辑链：把表面与埋藏结构分成不同信息需求 → 分别匹配SE形貌信号和TEM透射截面 → 需要指定局部区域时再采用FIB。

questions.prompt: A small electron source provides good directional coherence, but the acceleration conditions become unstable during phase imaging. Which conclusion is justified?

options.text: Good spatial coherence guarantees that temporal coherence remains unaffected.
Variations in electron energy can impair temporal coherence even when directional coherence remains good.
Changes in acceleration potential affect only electron delivery rate and not the electron energies.
The selected-area aperture selects electron energies and therefore removes the acceleration instability.

questions.explanation:
A 错：空间相干性与时间相干性是不同条件，不能由前者自动保证后者。
B 对：固定加速条件帮助保持电子能量与波的时间相干；能量变化仍可能影响相位成像，即使电子方向较一致。
C 错：加速电势影响单个电子的动能，不能把它仅当成控制电子数目的束流。
D 错：选区光阑限制样品区域，不是能量选择器，也不会修复加速条件不稳定。

重点词：spatial coherence（空间相干性）；temporal coherence（时间相干性）；acceleration stability（加速稳定性）。
逻辑链：小源有利于方向一致，加速稳定有利于能量一致 → 两种相干条件应分别判断 → 相位成像不能只检查一个条件。

questions.prompt: A useful BF overview is obtained, but selecting a DF reflection gives a weak image. Which assessments are reasonable?

options.text: Collecting only a fraction of the transmitted electrons can make DF intrinsically weaker than the overview.
A longer acquisition may help collect the DF signal, provided specimen changes during observation are considered.
Returning to BF can help verify the specimen area and shape without giving exactly the same reflection-selective information as DF.
Weakness or darkness under one selected reflection does not by itself establish that the target crystal phase is absent.

questions.explanation:
A 对：DF只接受所选衍射束的一部分电子，信号弱可来自收集条件，而非仪器或样品一定出了问题。
B 对：课件将较长采集列为弱DF信号的代价；同时应注意照射和观察时间可能带来的样品变化。
C 对：BF适合概览、尺寸与形状，DF则提供反射选择下的晶体学对比，两者可互补使用。
D 对：同一晶相的不同取向不一定都满足当前选定反射，单张弱或暗的DF像不足以证明该相不存在。

重点词：signal collection（信号收集）；selected reflection（选定反射）；acquisition trade-off（采集取舍）。
逻辑链：选束提高选择性但减少被收集电子 → 需要在信号、采集时间与样品稳定性之间取舍 → 先检查成像条件，再判断结构是否存在。
